messages:
anya (product): Quick UX check for API Keys surface before we ship: visibility rules, bulk actions (export/revoke), secret reveal UX, and copy/download error flows. Need final microcopy and accessibility notes.

ben (design): Main proposals: inline secret card after create with short banner 'Save this secret now — it won't be shown again.' Primary: 'Copy' button, secondary: 'Download .env'. Add a small help link 'how to rotate' nearby. For bulk view, add an 'Export keys' action that previews CSV.

faye (devex): Implementation notes: export should open a confirmation modal describing what will be included (key id, created, last_used, but never the secret). For bulk revoke, show a CSV preview and require typing the org name for safety on large sets.

omar (eng): Tech constraints: we must never return raw secret in any export. For download blob, generate JS Blob at creation and revoke references after nav. Mask secret in DOM after 15s and remove from memory. Also add fallback when navigator.clipboard is denied (show manual selection instructions).

lucy (a11y): Accessibility: after create, move focus to the secret card and use aria-live polite: 'API key created. Secret available for copying.' If clipboard fails, provide visible instructions and ensure screen reader can access the secret text (but keep it protected). For table, add an offscreen summary at top: 'You have X keys, Y restricted'.

tim (security): Security notes: callout about browser extensions — microcopy: 'Be aware: your browser extensions may capture clipboard contents.' Also add audit-link on each row. The export modal should warn that CSV can be sensitive and recommended admins only.

ben (design): Copy for export modal header: 'Export key metadata' and body: 'This will create a CSV of key IDs, names, creation date, and last used. Secrets are never exported.' CTA: 'Generate CSV' (primary) and 'Cancel' (secondary). For bulk revoke safety, use a big red action with typed confirmation.

faye (devex): UX for copy failure: if clipboard API blocked, show a small modal with the secret in a focusable code block and a button 'Select text' that focuses and selects it so users can use their OS copy. Also log a generic telemetry event 'clipboard_denied' (no secret).

omar (eng): Regarding role mapping: we'll add an optional SAML group mapping to Key Manager role in admin settings so orgs can control who sees secrets. Server-side gating on view requests.

lucy (a11y): Keyboard-only flow: provide a 'c' hotkey to open Create modal (power-user mode) — ensure it's discoverable in keyboard help and disableable for screen readers. Focus order in the dialog must be logical: name -> scope -> create. After creation, focus secret.

tim (security): For download .env content recommendation:
REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_live_XXXX
REDWOOD_REGION=us-west-2
# Keep this file secure
Include note in blob generation step.

ben (design): UI nit: add a tiny lock icon with tooltip 'Restricted view' on rows where secret viewing is denied. Tooltip copy: 'Requires Key Manager role'. Also show 'last used' column to encourage cleanup.

faye (devex): For bulk revoke undo: show a snackbar with 'Undo revoke' for 30s; if they revoke >50 keys require extra confirmation step. Also provide a CSV of affected key IDs in the snackbar 'Download affected list'.

lucy (a11y): Screen reader summary for revoke: when action completes announce 'N keys revoked' and ensure undo button reachable by keyboard and announced. Revoke confirm dialog must be role=alertdialog and trap focus.

omar (eng): Backend note: add last_used field and audit_link URL per key. Avoid exposing whether a secret was ever viewed in list payload to reduce attack surface.

tim (security): Small copy tweak for secret banner: prefer 'This is the only time you'll see the secret. Copy it now.' explicit. Also require a deprecation note in rotation docs when rotating keys with many dependents.

anya (product): Action items: ben -> update mock with export modal + lock badges + CSV preview; lucy -> write short ARIA snippets for create, export, revoke, and clipboard-fallback flows; faye -> spec CSV-export modal behavior and bulk-revoke typed confirm; omar -> API ticket for last_used + audit_link + SAML mapping. I'll add to sprint.
